title: The Grave Yard [1]
description: Sixteen haunted graves. Ten-player cooperative survival. Five 60-second zombie hunts separated by 60-second rests. Holding one of three tree gems grants immunity; tree climbing alone does not. Release the golden skull on the exit pedestal after hunt five. Captured players spectate; five-second all-dead reset. Quest validation pending.
